about_me_content:
I am a Full Stack Developer and AWS Cloud Specialist with around 3 years of experience at Tata Consultancy Services, where I led major infrastructure migrations and received the "Star of the Quarter" award. I’m currently pursuing my Master's in Computer Science at NYU Tandon School of Engineering with a GPA of 3.9/4.0.

My expertise spans building scalable cloud-native applications, architecting end-to-end infrastructure, and applying deep learning techniques to solve real-world challenges. At TCS, I led infrastructure teams and delivered high-impact cloud solutions across global projects.

At NYU, I’m expanding my focus on machine learning and AI, exploring topics like parameter-efficient LLM fine-tuning and adversarial robustness. I’m passionate about using technology to drive innovation, enhance system reliability, and create practical solutions with lasting impact.
